blurb: Guests experience scenic train excursions along the North Shore with options including short trips, longer rides, dining trains, and special event trains. Excursions range from short family rides to full-day trips with stops for lunch and touring. Special themed trains include pizza parties, beer tastings, and seasonal events like the Great Pumpkin Train.
